description: This is a PHP class file for the Goteo project, specifically implementing the SettingsDashboardController which manages user dashboard settings including profile, preferences, personal info, access permissions, and API key management.

classes.name: SettingsDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user dashboard settings, including profile editing, preferences, personal info, access, and API keys.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller and sets the context variable for 'settings'.

methods.name: createSettingsSidebar
methods.description: Generates the sidebar menu for the dashboard settings sections, adding links related to profile, personal info, access, preferences, API key, and public profile.

methods.name: profileAction
methods.description: Handles displaying and processing the user profile form, allowing editing of user information.

methods.name: profileTranslateAction
methods.description: Manages translations of user profile data into different languages, enabling editing or removal of translations.

methods.name: preferencesAction
methods.description: Displays and processes the user preferences form.

methods.name: personalAction
methods.description: Handles the form for editing user's personal data such as contract info and contact details.

methods.name: accessAction
methods.description: Allows changing user password and email, with validation and security measures.

methods.name: apikeyAction
methods.description: Handles API key generation and display for the user.
